case_title: BRIDGE INTERNATIONAL COMPANY VS LAW OFFICES OF MARK WEBB A PROFESSIONAL CORPORATIO

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY BRIDGE INTERNATIONAL COMPANY AS TO DEFENDANT LAW OFFICES OF MARK WEBB A PROFESSIONAL CORPORATIO ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUN-07-1999 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
SUBSTITUTED PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT LAW OFFICES OF MARK WEBB A PROFESSIONAL CORPORATIO

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BRIDGE INTERNATIONAL COMPANY IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT LAW OFFICES OF MARK WEBB A PROFESSIONAL CORPORATIO STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
